messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** periods in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday falling on a Friday or a Monday (or an observed holiday that moves the holiday to a Monday).

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3, 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Feb 18 – 20, 2023** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, BC, NB, NL, PEI, etc.) | Family Day is the third Monday in February in most provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – 9, 2023** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on Friday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 20 – 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Aug 5 – 7, 2023** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, PEI, NB, NL, etc.) | First Monday in August; many provinces observe it as a statutory holiday. |
| **Jul 1 – 3, 2023** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 2 – 4, 2023** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 – 13, 2023** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day is on Friday; the following weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Dec 23 – 25, 2023** | Christmas | Christmas Day is on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |

> **Provinces with additional long weekends (not federal):**  
> • **British Columbia:** Family Day (Feb 20) – already listed.  
> • **New Brunswick & Newfoundland & Labrador:** Family Day (Feb 20) – already listed.  
> • **Nova Scotia & Prince Edward Island:** Family Day (Feb 20) – already listed.  
> • **Ontario:** Civic Holiday (Aug 7) – already listed.  
> • **Quebec:** St. Jean‑Baptiste Day (Jun 24) – falls on Wednesday, so no long weekend.  

These are the only statutory holidays that create a true 3‑day weekend in Canada during 2023. If your app needs province‑specific holidays beyond those listed, let me know!
